summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Westminster School District to issue general obligation bonds, repaid by local property taxes, to fund classroom repairs and school safety, security, and facility improvements.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes bonds and the associated property-tax levy to fund school facility improvements.
tax.quote: levying $30 per $100,000 assessed value ($8,000,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding

schools.text: A Yes vote provides funding for repairs, technology, safety improvements, and equipment at Westminster School District schools.
schools.quote: Measure B provides the funding to begin addressing the identified Westminster School District facilities and technology needs.

tax.text: A No vote rejects the bond plan and does not authorize its associated property-tax levy.
tax.quote: levying $30 per $100,000 assessed value ($8,000,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding

schools.text: A No vote rejects funding for the proposed improvements at Westminster School District schools.
